name: EC4 Probe
author: Schwung
description: Bench probe for a Faderfox EC4 on Move's USB-A. Pads send the EC4's live SysEx (setup/group request, encoder-name text, the 4x20 overlay) and the tool decodes whatever comes back: SysEx replies, group/Shift/user-key reports, and the CCs and notes the encoders send. Answers whether SysEx crosses the USB-A port in each direction before any surface code depends on it.
